title: Epic Games Launcher data
whyItMatters: The launcher's Saved folder holds account-ID files, settings and local game saves. It shows which Epic accounts were used on this PC.
source: Epic Games support: account ID .dat files under %LOCALAPPDATA%/EpicGamesLauncher/Saved/Data - https://www.epicgames.com/help/c-45487929/c-38978022/what-is-an-epic-games-account-id-and-where-can-i-find-it-a24590453
notes: Account-ID files and save folders are counted, never opened. Game saves in other locations (Documents, Saved Games) are out of scope.
